title: ACTIVA: Amortized Causal Effect Estimation via Variational Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2503.01290v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Predicting post-intervention distributions from observational data is central to many scientific and decision-making problems, but remains challenging due to causal ambiguity, restrictive modeling assumptions, and the lack of amortization across tasks. We introduce ACTIVA, a transformer-based conditional variational autoencoder for amortized estimation of full interventional distributions from observational data and intervention queries. ACTIVA learns a conditional latent prior that amortizes causal knowledge across diverse training tasks, so that a new causal model drawn from the training distribution is handled in a single forward pass, without interventional data, a causal graph, or per-task fitting. Beyond the training distribution, only a parametric shift of the simulator is tested. tldr: ACTIVA是一个基于transformer的条件变分自编码器，能够仅通过观测数据在单次前向传播中摊销式地估计完整的干预分布，无需干预数据、因果图或逐任务拟合。
en_tdlr: ACTIVA is a transformer-based conditional variational autoencoder that amortizes the estimation of full interventional distributions from observational data in a single forward pass, without requiring interventional data, causal graphs, or per-task fitting.
